### Fixed

- (gs) [The Installations page's versions refetch never opens Login Required](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3121) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — After the portal sign-in expired, the Installations page's version columns no longer open the `Login Required` dialog by themselves, and show `Not signed in` instead of versions read earlier.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency vite to v8.3.2](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3113) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (gs) [The Login Required dialog names the caller that asked for it](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3129) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — While the `Login Required` dialog waits, the page names the request that opened it in an attribute, so browser tests can tell which one did. The dialog looks the same.
- (jest) [Keep the jest cache per worktree](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3131) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Each checkout keeps its own Jest cache in `node_modules/.cache/jest`, so a failing test's stack trace no longer points into another worktree's files.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.9.2...v3.9.3
